summary.trackingPolicy: Tracked reachable sources remain in the audit backlog but are removed from the active operator queue until adapter work is requested.

resolutionCategoryPolicy.INTEGRATED_STATIC: Validated official records are published in the appropriate static regional package.
resolutionCategoryPolicy.ENDPOINT_DISCOVERED_SCHEMA_PENDING: An official endpoint was found, but item-level fields or the documented request contract still need validation.
resolutionCategoryPolicy.ENDPOINT_DISCOVERED_NO_CURRENT_ITEMS: An official structured endpoint was verified, but it currently has no publishable current items.
resolutionCategoryPolicy.BLOCKED_SCHEMA: The official source lacks the required stable ID, explicit date/time, location, or item-level schema.
resolutionCategoryPolicy.BLOCKED_FRESHNESS: The official source has item-level data, but the sampled records are stale for publication.
resolutionCategoryPolicy.BLOCKED_ACCESS_OR_PERMISSION: Normal public access or owner authorization is missing; no bypass or mirror is permitted.
resolutionCategoryPolicy.BLOCKED_403: The official source returned 403 through normal access and requires an operator-provided export/API or reachable page.
resolutionCategoryPolicy.BLOCKED_CURRENT_ITEMS: The official source is reachable but has no current item-level records to publish.
resolutionCategoryPolicy.BLOCKED_CURRENT_SAMPLE: The sampled official records are canceled or otherwise not currently publishable.
resolutionCategoryPolicy.BLOCKED_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND: The recorded official endpoint no longer exists and needs a current official replacement.
resolutionCategoryPolicy.BLOCKED_EVENT_FEED_NOT_VERIFIED: An official calendar page exists, but no publishable event feed or item-level source was verified.
resolutionCategoryPolicy.DISCOVERY_ONLY_PERMIT_GUIDANCE: The replacement is permit or guidance content, not a scheduled meeting, event, or volunteer feed.

replacementAuditCoverage.note: Audit categories apply only to rows present in the replacement audit; the diagnostics remain authoritative for all 54 candidate rows.
